title: The Five Offspring the Body Brings Forth from Its Food
description: A single act of nourishment, taken into the body, divides into five distinct offspring: breath rising through the mind (thought), voice and speech (audible expression), discharge through power and shame (involuntary purgation), seed begotten through pleasure of desire (concupiscence), and the somatic child molded in flesh. The unregenerate human knows only the last and remains blind to the four interior emissions he is producing in every season.
